The shared-element function is a set intersection. The team note's alternatives don't satisfy the assert: a union would return {3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 10}, and a positional `zip` pairs (3,5), (4,7), (5,4), (6,10), which has no matches, so it would return nothing. The intersection gives {4, 5}, which matches the assert.

```python
def similar_elements(test_tup1, test_tup2):
    return tuple(set(test_tup1) & set(test_tup2))


assert set(similar_elements((3, 4, 5, 6), (5, 7, 4, 10))) == set((4, 5))
```
